answer: The admission bond is time locked for 18 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in nadir, expire in cedar, and ocean lists each expiry. Anyone running 49 aliases as a result needs 164 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4326 identities would post 919 proofs and burn roughly 55 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
